notes: Phase 01 CLOSED (Demo auth LIVE_DEMONSTRATED). Phase 06/07 Demo dispatcher lifecycle proven on venue (open/fill/close/flat, account FLAT, zero real capital). Phase 09 STRATEGY_EVALUATED_NO_ACTION, twice: once on 2026-09-30T09:21Z (Quant NEUTRAL, basis +0.115% vs 0.1222% hurdle) and again at 10:21Z after the regime/freshness slice (blocked EARLIER, at the benchmark gate, before Quant ran). Zero orders this phase. TWO REPRODUCED DEFECTS FIXED: (1) pre-flight hardcoded hoursToClose:1, so carry was understated ~65x during the Friday->Monday window it models; now regime-derived via market-regime.ts (0 while TradFi open, true hours to next 09:30 ET reopen when closed, ~65.5h across a weekend, DST-correct). (2) The GAP-015 freshness control existed and was unit-tested but had ZERO call sites in the real packet path; the pre-flight treated a successful MCP fetch as 'fresh' although equity_price_quote publishes NO timestamp. Freshness is now assessed via assessBenchmarkFreshness, which distinguishes upstream sourceAsOf from local fetchedAt, and buildPacket gates on it BEFORE Quant Boy, leaving quant null and non-executable when unverifiable. GAP-015 stays PARTIALLY_CLOSED (reproduced, not E2E_VERIFIED). NEW: GAP-017 HIGH->MEDIUM holidays/early closes unmodelled (documented limitation, pinned by test); GAP-018 HIGH no timestamped benchmark source exists, so every live run blocks at the benchmark gate. CLM-001/CLM-007 unchanged; live_evidence_current unchanged. NOT proven: live real-capital execution, settlement, funding accrual, liquidation, continuous operation, strategy profitability, or any order driven by a positive edge. Local baseline: engine 207/207 across 16 suites.
